The wording follows the owner-approved App Store description, which opens “Blanc for iPhone and iPad is the companion to Blanc”.

ipadAppStore.qualification: Blanc for iPhone and iPad 1.0.3, build 202611121714 from 44280ff1d (with #1479, iPad support, and #1480, the status bar fix), is the same free App Store listing as iPhone 1.0 (Apple ID 6828027794) and the first version that runs on iPad: TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY 1,2, iOS and iPadOS 18.4 or later, all four iPad orientations. On iPad, Blanc runs as a native full-screen app in every orientation, with Split View (two tabs side by side, SplitModel), a floating Glance card for links (GlanceCard), tabs in their own windows (WindowRoot, MultipleWindowsTests) and hardware-keyboard shortcuts such as ⌘L and ⌘T (BrowserCommands). Pages load their desktop layout by default, with Request Mobile Website per site (IslandMenu, SettingsStore, TabNavigationDelegate). It blocks ads and trackers with the bundled EasyList and EasyPrivacy rules and pairs with a desktop Sync as on iPhone. Not claimed: trackpad or pointer support (not tested on a real iPad), Stage Manager, or anything about the desktop app. There is no Android app. Held until App Review approves 1.0.3 (approvedOn) and it is on sale (publicRelease).

iphonePairing.qualification: Since desktop v1.45.0 (IPHONE_PAIRING_FROM is 1.45) Settings → Sync → Connect your iPhone, and Add device when Sync is on, show a QR code that Blanc for iPhone scans with Pair with your Blanc to join the same Sync, bringing Favorites and the other devices’ tabs. Android has no Blanc app.

syncWithoutPassphrase.qualification: Optional Sync keeps Favorites, settings and open tabs in step across computers, end-to-end encrypted; history and passwords never sync. See docs/website-v1.45-claims.json.

launchPing.qualification: Since #1479 the launch count Blanc for iPhone and iPad sends with Measure usage on carries a device field, iphone or ipad (LaunchPing.body), beside the install ID, session ID, app version, platform, architecture and OS major version; the ping Worker counts launches and new installs by device. Version 1.0.2 and earlier send no device field.
